<<Disposing of a Military Insignia Collection>>

If you're looking to get rid of your military insignia collection, one option is to consider adoption by a museum or a historical society. These organizations often accept donations of military artifacts and may be interested in your collection. You can also consider reaching out to local veterans' organizations or military reunions, as they may be interested in acquiring the collection for display or educational purposes.

******


<<Alternative Disposal Options>>

Another option for disposing of your military insignia collection is to consider donating it to a charity or thrift store that accepts donations of military artifacts. Some organizations, such as the Disabled American Veterans (DAV) or the USO, may be interested in accepting your collection. If you're not interested in donating the collection, you could also consider storing it in a secure location, such as a storage unit or a carriage, to keep it organized and protected. This would allow you to keep the collection for personal or family use while still keeping it out of the way.
